transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I'm here for my five-month diabetes and blood pressure check. I've also been having some pain in my right shoulder.

Could you tell me when the shoulder pain started and how it came on—whether suddenly or gradually, and what was happening when it began—and also whether you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
I can't remember exactly when it started, but it came on without any injury beforehand. As for allergies, I don't have any that I know of.
Could you tell me how much the shoulder pain is affecting you day to day, and what medicines you take regularly or have started or changed recently?

It mainly hurts with certain movements of my shoulder, and I haven't noticed it causing other problems day to day. I take medicines for my diabetes and high blood pressure, but I can't remember the names or doses.
On a scale from 0 to 10, how bad is the shoulder pain when it bothers you most?
I'm not sure—I can't really put a number on it.
Since the shoulder trouble started, have you noticed anything else going on with your shoulder or anywhere else in your body?
No, I haven't had any weakness, numbness, or tingling.
Apart from your diabetes and high blood pressure, is there anything else you see a doctor or nurse about regularly?

No, I don't see anyone regularly for anything else—just my diabetes and blood pressure. The only other thing was a benign breast biopsy back in 2004; I was told to have a repeat mammogram six months later, but I never had it.
Does the shoulder pain come and go, or is it there most of the time?
It mostly bothers me when I make certain movements with my shoulder. I haven't really noticed it being there all the time.
Have you ever had any operations or stays in hospital?
The breast biopsy in 2004 is the only procedure I've had. I can't recall any other operations or stays in hospital.
Since the shoulder problem started, have you noticed any changes in your appetite, sleep, weight, or energy, or have those stayed about the same?
I haven't noticed any changes there—my appetite, sleep, weight, and energy have all stayed about the same.
What worries you most about your shoulder at the moment?
I'm not especially worried about it—I mainly came for my routine diabetes and blood pressure check. The shoulder pain is the only other thing I've noticed.
How would you describe the feeling in your shoulder, in your own words?
It's just pain—I can't really describe it any better than that.
Is there anything else about your past health, or any other operations or hospital stays, that you’d like to add?
No, there's nothing else I can think of—just the diabetes, high blood pressure, and that benign breast biopsy in 2004.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
